ticker: Claude Haiku 5.5 ships — Anthropic's fastest, cheapest small model
OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with an 'Intelligent UI' for everyone
Mistral Large 4 preview — ~1T-param MoE, open weights to follow
EU AI Office says GPAI information requests are now operational
Lambda reportedly raising ~$4B pre-IPO on a backlog near $50B
IndiaAI Mission backs 20 sovereign models — 12 LLMs, 8 SLMs
Anthropic & Amazon lock in up to 5 GW of Trainium compute
Alibaba sues the Pentagon over its 'Chinese military company' listing

highlights.title: The US frontier now ships weekly
highlights.dek: Anthropic pushed Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and now Haiku 5.5 inside a month, while OpenAI opened its GPT-6 line to everyone. The cadence — not any single model — is the story: capability arrives in rapid, overlapping increments.

highlights.title: The open frontier still runs East
highlights.dek: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8-Max and DeepSeek's V4-Flash remain the open-weight pace-setters on price and capability, with Mistral Large 4 the main Western entry. The permissive Chinese stack stays the variable to watch.

highlights.title: EU enforcement turns real
highlights.dek: The AI Office says its requests for information to model providers are operational, not planned, with 150+ staff and model evaluations under way. No formal penalty has landed yet, but the evidence-gathering phase has begun.

highlights.title: India's sovereign stack scales up
highlights.dek: The IndiaAI Mission is now backing 20 indigenous models — 12 LLMs and 8 SLMs from Sarvam, BharatGen, Gnani and others — against 9.3M allocated GPU-hours. A widening programme, even as Krutrim's retrenchment shows the margin is thin.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 launches
items.blurb: Anthropic's new small model, pitched as its fastest, cheapest and most capable yet, for high-volume cost-sensitive work.

items.title: GPT-6 and an 'Intelligent UI' for everyone
items.blurb: OpenAI opens its GPT-6 family to general users with an adaptive interface, alongside an October developer guide.

items.title: Cyber Verification Program expands
items.blurb: Vetted security professionals get access to advanced cyber capabilities with reduced blocking, part of a new Cyber Mission.

items.title: OpenAI & Atlassian expand partnership
items.blurb: OpenAI models to power agents across Atlassian and Rovo; thousands of Atlassian developers already use Codex.

items.title: $100M to train 10,000 engineers
items.blurb: A commitment aimed at closing the enterprise AI talent gap by training 10,000 engineers.

items.title: Step 5 Preview on OpenRouter
items.blurb: A 600B sparse MoE (27B active) with 1M-token context; open weights said to follow around 15 Oct.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 (public preview)
items.blurb: ~1T-param MoE (49B active), 1M context, live API; open weights reported listed for end-October.

items.title: Index-Translate-35B-A3B opened
items.blurb: Open-weight MoE translation model (35B total, 3B active) covering ~150 languages.

items.title: Qwen 3.8-Max weights released
items.blurb: ~2.4T MoE (~95B active); Alibaba's first open-weight flagship, rated on par with Claude Sonnet 5.

items.title: DeepSeek V4-Flash-0731
items.blurb: 284B model reported within a point of GPT-5.6 at ~40% lower cost, with built-in speculative decoding.

items.title: 20 sovereign models backed
items.blurb: 12 LLMs and 8 SLMs — Sarvam, BharatGen, Gnani, Avataar — against 9.3M allocated GPU-hours.

items.title: Sarvam-105B 'Indus' + 30B, open-sourced
items.blurb: Apache-2.0 MoE, 128K context; India's sovereign-LLM entry on mission-provided compute.

items.title: India ranks 6th by national model
items.blurb: The country leaderboard places India 6th on the strength of Sarvam-105B — real but still trailing.

items.title: Krutrim retrenches
items.blurb: Shut its consumer assistant Kruti and paused its next model — a caution on the economics.

items.title: IndiaAI Mission & the rulebook
items.blurb: ₹10,372-crore, five-year programme; an AI Safety Institute, and IT Amendment Rules notified in February.

items.title: GPAI information requests operational
items.blurb: Director Sioli says requests for information to model providers are live, not planned; 150+ staff and model evaluations under way.

items.title: AI Act enforcement goes live
items.blurb: Powers over general-purpose model providers; fines reach €15M or 3% of global turnover.

items.title: Digital Omnibus delays high-risk rules
items.blurb: High-risk obligations pushed out 12–16 months; standalone Annex III now moves to December 2027.

items.title: Code of Practice at 180+ signatories
items.blurb: Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Mistral signed; Meta declined; xAI signed only the safety chapter.

items.title: Usage policy updated for 2026
items.blurb: Reported to add a section on not undermining democratic processes alongside its 2026 policy refresh.

items.title: Lambda raising up to $4B pre-IPO
items.blurb: Reportedly at a ~$14.5B pre-money valuation; backlog grew toward $50B, led largely by Anthropic's $35B commitment.

items.title: Tencent weighs ~$5B offshore bond
items.blurb: Said to be considering a bond sale to fund its AI buildout amid US chip-export restrictions.

items.title: Alibaba sues the Pentagon
items.blurb: Challenges its listing as a 'Chinese military company' under Section 1260H — a US–China commerce flashpoint.

items.title: Up to 5 GW of Trainium compute
items.blurb: A multi-year Anthropic–Amazon compute commitment at tens of billions in scale — compute as strategy.

items.title: Manus parent closes $500M+ round
items.blurb: Butterfly Effect reportedly raised over $500M at a targeted ~$4B valuation.
